app.name: AWS Bedrock Observability App
app.description: Runtime observability, cost & usage, and access governance for AWS Bedrock

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: Read the Bedrock ModelInvocationLog for token, cost, session, and error detail

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: Read CloudWatch metrics (cloud.aws.bedrock.*, cloud.aws.bedrock_guardrails.*) for latency, throughput, quota, and guardrails

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Read CloudTrail events (bedrock.amazonaws.com) for access & governance auditing

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: Required by Grail for bucket-level access to logs/events/metrics tables

scopes.name: storage:filter-segments:read
scopes.comment: Read tenant-defined filter segments to apply as scope filters

scopes.name: state:user-app-states:read
scopes.comment: Read per-user persisted state (timeframe, sampling, scan limit, tweaks, filters)

scopes.name: state:app-states:read
scopes.comment: Read org-wide app state (model rates shared across all users of this app)

scopes.name: state:app-states:write
scopes.comment: Persist org-wide app state (model rate edits made via the Model Rates panel)
